title: Predictive learning: computer vision
reading: The slide presents masked image modeling as a predictive self-supervised learning approach in computer vision, using the Masked Autoencoder (MAE) as the example: portions of an image are masked out and a Transformer is trained to predict the missing patches. It cites the CVPR 2022 paper 'Masked Autoencoders Are Scalable Vision Learners' as the reference.

concepts.name: Masked image modeling
concepts.why_it_matters: Self-supervised pretext task that yields visual representations without labels.

concepts.name: Transformer
concepts.why_it_matters: Backbone architecture operating on image patches.
